title: Redwire Veterans to Join Washington Commanders at “Salute to Service” Game
summary: As a Proud Drone Technology Partner of the Washington Commanders, Redwire’s leadership and a number of veteran employees will be a part of the Salute to Service gameday experience as the Commanders…
body_markdown:
As a Proud Drone Technology Partner of the Washington Commanders, Redwire’s leadership and a number of veteran employees will be a part of the Salute to Service gameday experience as the Commanders face off against the Los Angeles Rams. At this game, Redwire will also showcase its Commanders-branded Stalker Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS).


But appreciating our warfighters and their families doesn’t stop with one game. Redwire volunteers recently co-hosted **a[youth football clinic](https://rdw.com/newsroom/redwire-co-hosts-youth-football-clinic-for-military-families-with-washington-commanders/) for military kids** with Commanders coaches and staff at Marine Corps Base Quantico. Redwire also supports the care and training of **TJ,** who is not just[the Commanders’ team dog](https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-welcome-team-dog-partnership-redwire) but a service dog in training with the[Warrior Canine Connection](https://warriorcanineconnection.org/?gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=203709201&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIi43lzu_XlwMVuTgIBR0d4TuxEAAYASAAEgKGRfD_BwE) who will provide companionship and support for a veteran.


The Salute to Service game day experience is part of **Redwire’s**[multi-year partnership](https://rdw.com/newsroom/redwire-becomes-proud-drone-technology-partner-of-the-washington-commanders-to-showcase-military-appreciation/) with the Washington Commanders to honor U.S. service members, veterans, and military families. This partnership also underscores Redwire’s broader role as a global defense technology leader that is advancing U.S. leadership in drone technology, strengthening the domestic drone manufacturing base, and ensuring that the benefits of combat-proven drone technology are delivered to U.S. armed forces.


**Learn more about Redwire’s partnership with the Washington Commanders at**[RDW.com](https://rdw.com/newsroom/redwire-becomes-proud-drone-technology-partner-of-the-washington-commanders-to-showcase-military-appreciation/) **.**
